last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Thu 08-27, day 16 in country. EAR DAY, AND THE EAR PAID TWICE. Opened by finally delivering the Swapna greeting he asked the cloud channel for three times this morning and never got - the knock lane cannot attach a file, so it replied without one and he called out the mechanics (a transient job in a GitHub runner). Rendered it on the laptop with render_demo, five -nga lines, and gave him the real choice: send the robot, or shadow it and send his own voice. HE ALSO TOLD ME MY CHAT REGISTER HAD GONE JARGONY - he did not know what file as-is meant. Plain words, always. THE FIRST WIN CAME UNPROMPTED: finally konjam is a word I am remembering. The soak that shipped at 15:15 was the konjam-vs-sinna dose and it landed the same day - soak to mouth in one cycle, the third time that recipe has paid. EAVESDROP, TWO AUNTIES, FULL SPEED. He got the OUTCOME right (she ate) and - this is the one - HE CLEARED THE KADAISILA TRAP that sent him shopping 24 hours earlier. Same word, same speed, right answer. But I asked instead of crediting, and the honest answer was that he caught the last line only: he MISSED THE REVERSAL. Two reasons, both worth having. (1) INNIKKI WAS FOG BY EAR. Taught it: indha naal worn down to innikki, with nethu and naalaikki, and the -kki tail he already fires in beach-ku. THE REAL FIND: her maami asks INNIKKI ENNA PANNINGA every single night and the first word of his most reliable daily opening was noise. That is fixed. (2) HE MISSED SAAPDALA WHOLE - and he FIRES puriyala and mudiyala cold. He owns the -la negative in his MOUTH and had never met the machine in his EAR. That is the machines-heard bottleneck in one clean instance, and it is what I commissioned. THREE FIRES. (1) Asked for a confession (kekkala), got a REPAIR: konjam medhuva solla. He out-thought the ticket - puriyala ends the exchange, konjam medhuva sollunga keeps it alive and gets the address. konjam fired COLD in a slot I never set up for it, an hour after he said it was sticking. SLIP: he dropped the -nga imperative (solla for sollunga) to a stranger doing him a service - the same tail he puts on thirumbunga and ponga without thinking. First instance, watched, not dosed. (2) hair stylist-ku ponom, romba nallaa irundhuchu - frame:day-recap on a place I never gave him, English noun plus Tamil tail, the Noun Shortcut working exactly as designed. I DID NOT CREDIT PONOM UNTIL I ASKED whether he went alone; he confirmed we went. So 1pl-past-om LANDED - unaided, two days running, novel slot, after being unstable in BOTH directions for a month. Marked landed. He is building that sentence now, not remembering it. (3) Maami mask, plate attack: podhum podhum, vairu full. BOTH COLD, and I nearly logged the second as a slip before checking - vayiru full is a REAL ENTRY IN HIS OWN LEXICON. An invented slip corrupts the ledger exactly like an invented win. Gave vendaamma vayiru nirenjiduchu as an UPGRADE, never a correction. This is the declining set - the campaign through-line - firing at the table for the first time. COMMISSIONED: the -la negative BY EAR (soak lane), permuted across verbs he already owns, innikki riding in the frames. STILL OPEN: english-word-order 3x over 23d, STILL undosed - the 08-19 carve broke under him and I will not build a dose on a rule I cannot defend. chunk-not-machine did not fire today. copula-for-identity did not recur. pirandha naal vazhthukkal: in curriculum, no deadline. MISSION TONIGHT - an ANSWER with a guaranteed slot, per the 08-26 finding: when she comes at his plate, podhum podhum plus the tail. The room speaks first, every meal. LAST NIGHTS MISSION COLLECT IS PENDING - asked at close whether the innikki answer flew at supper. TOMORROW OFFERED: the -la soak by ear, low-power twin is the same tape with no answering.
